title: Exploratory oracle — per-finding adversarial verify output

is_real.description: true if this is a plausible REAL firmware bug on the target release pair, not a harness artifact / expected behavior

refutation.description: if is_real=false, the concrete reason it is refuted (artifact, fidelity gap, expected, already-tested-correct). Empty if is_real=true.

source_evidence.description: firmware source / test / spec refs actually checked (file:line)

repro_sketch.description: if is_real, how to build a minimal deterministic reproducer (chain factory, stimulus calls, oracle assert). Empty if is_real=false.
